title: Get noli anims
features: Go to forsaken and execute this script. Then noli Milestones will work (pls don't change anything and please listen to the warning to not set anything lower than 5)
script:
local Settings = {
FileName = "Noli Milestone 4";
Animations = {
        Idle  = "rbxassetid://110933164243478",
        Walk = "rbxassetid://132550421221296",
        Run = "rbxassetid://105441420067903",
        Stab = "rbxassetid://92567970681901",
        Outro = "rbxassetid://89207009102595",
        VoidRushStart = "rbxassetid://95977028582843",
        VoidRushLoop = "rbxassetid://93841120533318",
        StartDashInit = "rbxassetid://100767584148154",
        LoopDashInit = "rbxassetid://84449964607732",
        StartDashCombo = "rbxassetid://114356208094580",
        LoopDashCombo = "rbxassetid://84449964607732",
        VoidRushEnd = "rbxassetid://139321362207112",
        VoidRushCrash = "rbxassetid://129613827182782",
        EndDashNonChar = "rbxassetid://129613827182782",
        WeakHit = "rbxassetid://92243093913547",
        Nova = "rbxassetid://74955323199805",
        NovaDet = "rbxassetid://126809454253704",
        ObservantStart = "rbxassetid://113357690193035",
        ObservantLoop = "rbxassetid://83979618722348",
        ObservantTeleport = "rbxassetid://140042539182927",
        Intro = "rbxassetid://82002727792391",
        Kill = "rbxassetid://93946634018878",
        StunStart = "rbxassetid://128923537868786",
        StunLoop = "rbxassetid://122580527125278",
        StunEnd = "rbxassetid://99164529472582"
  };
DownloadDelay = 5.5; -- DONT SET ANY LOWER THAN 5.
}

local ExportedAnims = Instance.new("Folder")
ExportedAnims.Name = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
ExportedAnims.Parent = workspace

for Name, ID in pairs(Settings.Animations) do
    local Success, Parent = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects(ID)[1]
    end)
    if Success and Parent then
        Parent.Name = Name
        Parent.Parent = ExportedAnims
        print("Imported:", Name, ID)
    else
        warn("Failed to import:", Name, ID, "Error:", Parent)
    end
end

task.wait(Settings.DownloadDelay)

local SynSaveInstance = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luau/SynSaveInstance/main/saveinstance.luau", true), "saveinstance")()
SynSaveInstance({Object = ExportedAnims, FilePath = Settings.FileName})
